before: A complete body row below a repeated header reserved its own top rule on the shared border plan, and the band of the row it was authored under on the ordinary repeat path.
after: Before compatibility mode 15 the row reserves the wider of its own top rule and the header's bottom rule; from mode 15 it reserves the band it shares with the row above it in the table, on both paths.
reason: Only local layout geometry changes. Canonical XML, replicated operations, and saved rooms remain unchanged.
